paper.title_en: The third law of black hole thermodynamics and the mass-to-charge ratio of scalar fields
paper.abstract_en: Kehle and Unger have recently shown that self-gravitating charged classical scalar fields can collapse to form extremal Reissner-Nordström (eRN) black holes in finite time, thus violating the third law of thermodynamics (TLT). Reall has subsequently proved that the formation of an eRN black hole in gravitational collapse is impossible if the mass-to-charge ratio of the field exceeds unity, $m/e\geq1$. In the present compact paper we conjecture, using quantum considerations, that the Reall bound is {\it not} sharp. In particular, we point out that the electric field of a charged system with charge $Q$ will spontaneously polarize the vacuum in the regime $(eQ/\hbar)^2>(mQ/\hbar)^2+1/4$, thereby creating pairs of charged particles that discharge the black hole and ensure the quantum validity of the TLT in this regime. Motivated by the TLT, we conjecture that the classical Reall bound can be strengthened such that classical considerations would prevent eRN black holes from forming dynamically in the regime $m/e\geq\sqrt{1-\big({{\hbar}/{2eQ}}\big)^2}$, where quantum polarization effects are unable to protect the TLT.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文直接探讨黑洞热力学第三定律在带电标量场坍缩中的量子修正，提出对Reall经典界的量子强化猜想，主题高度契合，理论深度较强，对判断是否值得精读有明确信号。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞热力学第三定律与标量场的质荷比
decision.abstract_zh: Kehle和Unger最近表明，自引力带电经典标量场可以在有限时间内坍缩形成极端Reissner-Nordström（eRN）黑洞，从而违反热力学第三定律（TLT）。随后Reall证明，如果场的质荷比超过1，即$m/e\geq1$，则引力坍缩中形成eRN黑洞是不可能的。在这篇简短的论文中，我们利用量子考量推测，Reall界并非尖锐的。特别地，我们指出，电荷为$Q$的带电系统的电场会在$(eQ/\hbar)^2>(mQ/\hbar)^2+1/4$的范围内自发极化真空，从而产生带电粒子对，使黑洞放电，并确保TLT在该范围内量子有效。受TLT启发，我们推测经典Reall界可以被加强，使得在$m/e\geq\sqrt{1-\big({{\hbar}/{2eQ}}\big)^2}$的范围内，经典考量会阻止eRN黑洞动态形成，而量子极化效应无法保护TLT。
